tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.description:

- bs_build_rows: schwung, others alpha, stock appended; no overflow
- make -C tests/host test green

tasks.subject: Task 4: boot-select binary (SPI window + picker)

- Modify: scripts/build.sh (~line 836, link block copying shadow_ui's quickjs include/lib paths from build.sh:343-352)

**Acceptance Criteria:**

- --forced <id>: no window, banner '<name> failed to start', cursor on stock
- Picker: jog scrolls, click writes default (tmp+rename) + prints id, Back cancels printing incoming id
- Failure -> exit 1, empty stdout; SPI fd closed + munmap before exit
- ./scripts/build.sh emits ARM aarch64 build/bin/boot-select; host tests still green

**Verify:** ./scripts/build.sh && file build/bin/boot-select (aarch64) && make -C tests/host test
